verdicts.why: Sarge takes Mack hostage on Zephyr One in S6#9 and only turns on May as Pachakutiq in S6#12; in S6#13 at the Temple of the Forgotten he outfights Mack until May passes Mack the sword she was stabbed with and Mack cuts Sarge in two with it.

proposed.text: Jiaying begs S.H.I.E.L.D. to bring Kora back to her from Afterlife, but Nathaniel Malick, the man Kora turned on her to follow, kills Jiaying at the Lighthouse.

verdicts.why: The proposal is right that the stage should be about the two of them, and Jiaying does plead with the team to bring her daughter back, but Kora never left Afterlife (she and Malick took it over in S7#8, and in S7#10 Jiaying is the one at the Lighthouse), and 'kills her' could be read as Kora, so this wording fixes both.

'Malick's son' is true: Nathaniel is Wilfred Malick's son, the Malick Simmons knew in 1931 and 1955, and in this very episode he quakes Deke 'for Wilfred Malick'; stage 0 uses the same words, so nothing on the card is false.

In 'Longshot' (#36, and Jubilee is not in the earlier Mojovision) Jubilee fights Spiral's party alongside Longshot, then Mojo, disguised as a scarecrow, takes her in the woods, and the X-Men have to fight through his televised hunt to save her.
Sinister flies Beast, Forge and Warlock out on his ship at the end of Part 1 (#67); in Part 2 (#68) the group makes the virus on Muir Island, and there is no rescue.

Deathlok shoots Garrett and crushes his head, which only seems to kill him; Garrett gets up, starts turning himself into a cyborg, and Coulson vaporizes him with the 0-8-4, so 'strikes Garrett down' is right and 'kills' is wrong.
In S2#2 Creel already has the Obelisk, which he stole in S2#1; he turns down Raina's offer and warns her that Hydra would hurt her, but he walks off with the carbyne ring.

Bakshi calls Whitehall 'a disciple of Red Skull' to Bobbi Morse in S2#8 'The Things We Bury'; in S2#1 he only reports to Whitehall that Creel has the Obelisk, so on the S2#1 stage the line is a later spoiler.

In S2#5 and S2#7 Hunter and Bobbi only bicker as exes; they get back together in S2#8, when an argument ends with them having sex in an SUV, so 'fall back in love' on the S2#5 stage gives away S2#8 (that turn has no stage of its own).

In S3#17 they first meet on the Secret Warriors rescue, where Lincoln captures Malick, and they defy Coulson at the lockdown; then, once the Kree beacon turns up in Lincoln's locker, Yo-Yo goes at him with Overpowering Tape, his electricity knocks her out, and she leaves S.H.I.E.L.D.

The team locks Fitz and Aida in the containment chamber together, and Aida attacks Fitz when he says he loves Simmons; Piper, Davis and Prince pull him out, and Piper gets Fitz onto the Zephyr. Fitz never traps Aida.
Ruby is chasing Coulson and Talbot, not Daisy, when Daisy steps in; Ruby tells her 'I want to beat you', they fight, and Daisy's shockwave throws her into a tree and knocks her out.

At Cassie's party in Ant-Man, Maggie tells Scott to get an apartment and a job and pay child support before they talk about visits, and to be the hero Cassie thinks he is; the promise to quit crime comes only from the tie-in comic.

Karja leads the Orgosentries and heads security on the Orgoscope, while Orgocorp itself is run by the High Evolutionary, so 'the Orgocorp chief' is wrong and 'the Orgoscope's security chief' is right.
